title: Every loader reads the alias table's path from configuration (R1007 slice 1)
body:
Slice 1 of `docs/plans/oracle/tracked-alias-table.md` — **OD-11 / R1007**, evidence **BL-4** and **BL-6**.

`alias_table_path` becomes a flat `config.toml` key holding a full path to the file. Both loaders — `select_all` and the `aliases` recall report — read it and neither builds a path any more.

**The table stops following `data_dir`.** It is hand-authored input; the cache is not. Pointing `data_dir` at another cache must not silently relocate the table with it.

`_missing` recognises the alias table by comparing against the configured path instead of a filename suffix. With the name a lever, a suffix test is a guess about a name the owner now chooses. No message wording changes.

**Nothing moves yet.** The default is still `data/aliases.toml`, where the table still is, so there is no broken intermediate state. Slice 2 does the `git mv` and flips the default together, which is what R1007 requires happen in one change.

**Two test helpers changed, deliberately.** `tests/test_aliases.py` and `tests/test_select.py` now set `alias_table_path` explicitly. Two reasons: the default is no longer `data_dir`-relative so those bodies would break, and setting it makes both suites exercise a configured, non-default path throughout — the clause of R1007 they are best placed to pin. The other eight `make_config` helpers are untouched; they never load the table.

7 new tests, 481 passing. Offline throughout.
